portal_description:
NetworkManager is a system network service that manages network devices and connections, attempting to keep active network connectivity when available. Its capabilities include managing Ethernet, wireless, mobile broadband (WWAN), and PPPoE devices, as well as providing VPN integration with a variety of different VPN services.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* Due to a bug in the NetworkManager service, a restart of NetworkManager stopped the teamd daemon without restarting it. As a consequence, team connections did not operate correctly after the service restart. This bug has been fixed, and NetworkManager now generates a new teamd instance when the service is restarted. (BZ#1569924)

* Previously, NetworkManager failed to automatically activate child connections when the parent device was not managed by NetworkManager yet. As a result, VLAN or other connection type were not correctly activated at boot time. This bug has been fixed, and child connections now are activated as soon as the parent connection becomes available. (BZ#1570521)

* Due to a bug, NetworkManager did not correctly connect all slaves when the master connection was activated and the autoconnect-slaves option was set. This bug has been fixed, and slaves connections now are always activated if autoconnect-slaves is set. (BZ#1570522)

Users of NetworkManager are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
